messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick sync — QBR for NorthStar on Thurs 4/9 9am PT. Need slide owners + one-line exec ask by EOD tomorrow. Also flagging renewal risk and enablement gaps.
Liam (AE): I can own 'business impact & usage' slide. Exec ask: request exec time for reference case with CTO.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll take 'integration & performance' — will include latency/cost charts. Need prod request logs from last 30 days. @Eloise can you surface?
Eloise (CS Ops): Yup prepping a tokenized usage export. Uploading to the shared folder now: https://drive.redwood/example-northstar-qbr
Priya (Product PM): I'll own 'roadmap alignment' slide. Quick ask: show roadmap items that reduce inference cost — want concrete ETA bullets.
Zara (RevOps): Put renewal health tier = At-Risk (R2) in the summary slide. Current ARR: $420k, renewal target 5/1. Proposed discount/commit options to discuss in canary.
Maya (CSM): Action list so far: 1) Liam — Biz impact slide + topline exec ask; 2) Noah — perf/cost metrics (logs from Eloise); 3) Priya — roadmap bullets; 4) Zara — renewal options & pricing ask. Add owners for enablement/demo?
Tom (Customer): Happy to jump on a 15-min demo after QBR to walk through telemetry. Also can provide a quote about uptime that we can include.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Quick note — perf data shows a KV cache miss spike on 3/22. I'll add a one-slide 'risk & mitigation' with suggested config changes and expected cost delta.
Eloise (CS Ops): Uploaded: `northstar_qbr_usage_30d.csv` and `latency_summary_30d.pdf`. Link in Drive.
Maya (CSM): Can everyone drop a 1-sentence summary in this thread so I can stitch the exec one-pager? Example: "Liam: Strong adoption in search; ask for CTO time to approve reference case."
Liam (AE): 1-sentence: Strong adoption in search; ask for CTO time to approve reference case and sign off on joint PR.
Noah (Solutions Eng): 1-sentence: Integration stable but KV cache misses drive cost; propose config + small infra change to address.
Priya (Product PM): 1-sentence: Roadmap includes model quantization and autoscaling improvements that lower token cost; ETA Q3 alpha.
Zara (RevOps): 1-sentence: Renewal at-risk due to unit economics; propose 6-month committed capacity + adoption milestone discount.
Tom (Customer): 1-sentence: We'll provide a short uptime quote and take the post-QBR demo.
Maya (CSM): Great — next steps: I will assemble slides tonight. Please upload final slide drafts to the Drive slide deck (edit rights) by EOD tomorrow. Reminder-bot will ping 12h before the cut. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
reminder-bot: Reminder set — will DM owners 12 hours before "slides due" deadline.
Eloise (CS Ops): Small request: can someone confirm the executive audience list? I have VP Eng and Head of Product confirmed; any others?
Liam (AE): Add CFO for finance questions — I'll invite.
Maya (CSM): Adding CFO and CTO. Also prepping a 2-slide appendix with renewal options and sample contract amendment.
Priya (Product PM): One more ask — can we include a simple ROI calc (savings per 100k tokens) in the appendix? I'll draft numbers and tag @Zara for pricing inputs.
Zara (RevOps): On it — will drop conservative and aggressive scenarios in the sheet.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all. If anyone needs to hand off slide ownership, please call it out now. Otherwise I'll treat current owners as final and run a dry run Wed 4/8 10am PT. :raised_hands:
Noah (Solutions Eng): I might be OOO afternoon Tues — if I don't finish slide early, I'll hand to @Noah_backup (cc'd in calendar).
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll confirm backup owners in the draft deck.
Liam (AE): LGTM.
Tom (Customer): Thanks team — looking forward to the session.
Maya (CSM): Closing notes: I'll produce the one-page exec ask doc after slides land. Expected deliverable timeline: slides by EOD tomorrow, dry run Wed 10am PT, final deck Thu 6am PT.
Eloise (CS Ops): A couple of quick checklist items I'm tracking: speaker names, slides <= 6, 1-slide risks, 1-slide renewal options, appendix. Will post checklist link shortly.
Maya (CSM): Perfect — thanks everyone. :sparkles:
